_about: PW-2: every CoreModule exported under src/core2/modules runs in the world the owner plays (buildBenchWorld), or is listed under exemptions with an allowed reason: 'a library other modules import, not an engine', or 'replaced by <module>, remove in <package>' with a registered stopgap. 'Not ready' is not a reason. Files under src/core2/modules that export no CoreModule are listed under libraries with what they are. tests/golden-path/module-guard.test.ts fails on a module in neither list, on an exemption for an installed module, and on a library file that exports a module.

libraries.reason: A library other modules import, not an engine: the economy's module list (WORLD_MODULES), its opening input and its parameters.
A library other modules import, not an engine: read-only panels over other modules' tables for the bench and /play.
